name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  web:
    name: Lint, typecheck, build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      - run: npm run test:web

  contracts:
    name: Compile and test contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npx hardhat compile
      - run: npm run test:contracts

name: Deploy governance to RSK testnet

# Manual only. Requires the "rsk-testnet" environment with:
#   secret   DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY  (a dedicated testnet-only key funded with tRBTC)
#   variable GUARDIAN_ADDRESS      (optional emergency canceller, e.g. a multisig)
#   variable RSK_TESTNET_RPC_URL   (optional; defaults to the public RSK node)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm:
        description: 'Type "deploy-testnet" to confirm'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: deploy-rsk-testnet
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: ${{ github.event.inputs.confirm == 'deploy-testnet' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: rsk-testnet
    env:
      DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      GUARDIAN_ADDRESS: ${{ vars.GUARDIAN_ADDRESS }}
      RSK_TESTNET_RPC_URL: ${{ vars.RSK_TESTNET_RPC_URL || 'https://public-node.testnet.rsk.co' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Gate — full contract test suite must pass
        run: npm run test:contracts

      - name: Gate — rehearse the exact deploy in-process
        run: npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.cjs --network hardhat

      - name: Check secrets are present
        run: |
          if [ -z "$DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY secret is not set on the rsk-testnet environment"; exit 1
          fi

      - name: Deploy to RSK testnet
        run: npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.cjs --network rskTestnet

      - name: Smoke test (read-only) against RSK testnet
        run: npx hardhat run scripts/smoke-governance.cjs --network rskTestnet

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "## RSK testnet deployment"
            if [ -f deployments/rskTestnet.json ]; then
              echo '```json'; cat deployments/rskTestnet.json; echo '```'
              echo "Commit \`deployments/rskTestnet.json\` from the artifact to record these addresses."
            else
              echo "No deployment file written. See the log artifact."
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload deployment record + logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rsk-testnet-deployment
          path: |
            deployments/rskTestnet.json
            deployments/logs/
          if-no-files-found: warn
